excerpt.zh: 这一文明演化出了一种异养于其他智慧生命形态的寄生体。当它踏入星系舞台时，其他的物种或是被视作侍徒而带入他们的行列，要么就成为他们的食物。在食尸者面前，没有第三种选择。
excerpt.en: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.

sections.zh:
在并不遥远的过去，[GetHomeWorldName]被一个相当平凡的物种所统治着。在旁观者看来，他们似乎经历了标准的曲折发展历程，有偶然的高速创新时期也有大量看上去漫长而难以逾越的瓶颈。然而，不为他们所知的是，他们的星球已经成为了另一智慧物种——我们——的据点。

几千年来，我们——[GetSpeciesNamePlural]——并未被这颗星球的主人所发现。仅仅流传着一些夜晚的模糊的恐怖谣言，我们仅仅是被拿来恐吓不听话小孩的虚构人物。然而他们错误地低估了我们。

随着他们技术发展的加快，我们也加速渗透着他们的社会。他们迅速且血腥地沦陷。我们雷厉风行地掌控了他们的星球——这颗星球的前主人不得不屈服并逐渐成为[GetSpeciesName]的一员。

现在，实装了近期刚发现的超光速旅行秘密的我们已经准备好走向星河的舞台，并把全星系的所有物种改造成我们的样子！
sections.en:
In the not-so-distant past, [GetHomeWorldName] was dominated by a fairly unremarkable species. To all onlookers, they would have seemed to be following a standard meandering course of development, with occasionally rapid periods of innovation interspersed with much longer periods of seemingly insurmountable setbacks. However, unbeknownst to them, their planet was home to a second intelligent species: us.

For millennia, we - the [GetSpeciesNamePlural] - remained undetected by the planet's proprietors. Little more than vague rumors of terrors in the night, we were a fairytale told only to scare misbehaving juveniles. But they were wrong to discount us.

As their rate of technological progress quickened, so too did our infiltration of their society. When their fall came, it was swift and bloody. We ruthlessly took control of the planet - our precursors reduced to subservience and gradual absorption into the [GetSpeciesName] race.

Now armed with the recently-discovered secret of FTL travel, we are ready to take to the stars and remake all species of the galaxy in our likeness!

而如今我们已经掌握了超光速旅行的秘密，我们终于能够在群星间遨游，在未来的星系帝国舞台上夺得我们的一席之地！

To all onlookers, they would have seemed to be following a standard meandering course of development, with occasionally rapid periods of innovation interspersed with much longer periods of seemingly insurmountable setbacks. However, unbeknownst to them, their planet was home to a second intelligent species: us.

sections.zh:
在并不遥远的过去，那艘最终归属于我们的宏伟方舟，其上的船员都是一群相当平凡的物种。在旁观者看来，他们似乎经历了标准的曲折发展历程，有偶然的高速创新时期也有大量看上去漫长而难以逾越的瓶颈。然而，不为他们所知的是，他们的飞船中还潜藏着另一个智慧物种——我们。

几千年来，我们，[GetSpeciesNamePlural]，一直躲藏在飞船中那些被遗忘的走廊和封闭的舱室之中，从未被发现。我们不过是关于黑暗中恐怖之物的模糊传言，一个只是用来吓唬不听话小孩的恐怖传说。然而他们错误地低估了我们。

随着他们技术发展的加快，我们也加速渗透着他们的社会。

当他们的末日来临时，一切迅速而血腥。我们无情地夺取了飞船的控制权，飞船原本的主人沦为了附庸，并逐渐被[GetSpeciesName]所同化。

如今，方舟已归于我们之手，其航向亦由我们裁定。我们将踏星而行，穿越虚空。星海万族，终将被重塑为吾等之形！
sections.en:
In the not-so-distant past, the great arkship that would become ours was crewed by a fairly unremarkable species. To all onlookers, they would have seemed to be following a standard meandering course of development, with occasionally rapid periods of innovation interspersed with much longer periods of seemingly insurmountable setbacks. However, unbeknownst to them, their vessel harbored a second intelligent species: us.

For millennia, we, the [GetSpeciesNamePlural], remained undetected within the ship's forgotten corridors and sealed compartments. Little more than vague rumors of terrors in the dark, we were a fairytale told only to scare misbehaving juveniles. But they were wrong to discount us.

As their rate of technological progress quickened, so too did our infiltration of their society.

When their fall came, it was swift and bloody. We ruthlessly seized control of the vessel, our precursors reduced to subservience and gradual absorption into the [GetSpeciesName] race.

The arkship is ours now, its heading ours to set. We are ready to chart our own course through the stars and remake all species of the galaxy in our likeness!
